# Compute v2

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's compute/v2 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

| Operation | openstacksdk | Go |
|---|---|---|
| Service access | `conn.compute` | `conn.ComputeV2(ctx)` |
| Optional arguments and defaults | keyword arguments | concrete options and operation-specific `With...Options` |
| Extension inputs | `**attrs`, `**query` | supported `With...Field/Query/Header` options |
| Results | Resource or generator | typed values and errors, or `iter.Seq2` |

Native API coverage and openstacksdk Resource/workflow coverage are tracked separately. Python input aliases are not automatically applied to Go fields. Default responses use Gophercloud models; SDK-owned additions are documented per service. Editing a returned response does not automatically persist it.

Selected stateful resources provide `WaitForState(ctx, ref, target, options...)` and `WaitForDelete(ctx, ref, options...)`. State waits use the service's exact ERROR/error failure defaults and no SDK timeout; deletion observation defaults to 120 seconds, with a 2-second interval. Compute Server `WaitForServer` defaults to ACTIVE and 120 seconds; Cinder Volume/Snapshot `WaitForAvailable` defaults to available. Caller `resource.With...` options apply last. Common `WaitFor/WaitForDeletion` retain their 5-minute default; native `WaitForStatus` has a separate contract. See [wait policies](../../docs/service-waits.md).

`Servers/Flavors.FindIdentity(ctx, identity, options...)` resolves name/ID strings automatically, with list fallback after GET400/403/404, exact ID/name and duplicate checks, and a default missing result of `nil, nil`. Select strict handling with `resource.WithIdentityFindIgnoreMissing(false)`. Caller `WithIdentityFindQuery` filters survive GET and fallback listing; automatic name hints apply only to listing. Concrete options control query/fallback. See [identity finding](../../docs/finding-identities.md) for binding, fixed parents, domain filters and path policy.

Server/volume identity finding can use summary fallback with `resource.WithIdentityFindDetails(false)` or cross-project listing with `resource.WithIdentityFindAllProjects(true)`. Defaults are details=true/all_projects=false, without changing GET. Explicit AllProjects conflicts with raw all_tenants query before HTTP.

`KeyPairs.ListRecords` provides raw keypair records, local filters and pagination controls. `KeyPairs.FindKeypair` tries a direct name GET, searching the same owner's list only after actual400/403/404. See [keypair list/find](../keypairs-list-find.md) for default ssh, nullable fields, default ignore-missing, version selection and native List/Find differences.

[Cloud keypairs](../keypairs-cloud.md) covers SDK-owned inventory, two-stage filtering, owner selection and missing results for list/search/create/delete.

[Explicit flavor extra specs](../flavor-extra-specs.md) always performs GET even when inline values exist, separating the Source dict view from actual raw specs.

[Flavor properties and native reads](../flavor-property-and-native.md) covers strict-ID enrichment defaults, raw property values and distinct native Get/GetExtraSpec/ListDetail results.

[Flavor records](../flavor-records.md) covers `service.ListFlavors`/`FindFlavor` and `API.Flavors.ListRecords`/`FindFlavor`: query aliases, descriptor defaults, pagination, conditional specs enrichment and independent Resource/Wire responses.

[Cloud flavor reads](../flavor-cloud.md) covers eager `AllFlavors`, enrichment-before-filtering in `SearchFlavors`, direct Find delegation in `GetFlavor`, and different extra-specs defaults.

[Availability zones](../availability-zones.md) covers raw/null records, unavailable defaults, Cloud failure handling and native single-page behaviour. Detailed host reads remain a separate admin-level scope.

`conn.Compute(ctx).ValidateConsoleAuthToken(ctx, token)` fetches console-token connection information directly, returning seeded Resource, actual Wire and HTTP receipt. The required token is distinct from provider authentication. See [console auth tokens](../console-auth-token.md) for nullable results and the 2.99 ceiling when a version is not selected.

Higher-level `conn.Compute(ctx).CreateConsole(ctx, serverID, type, options...)` selects modern/legacy consoles from advertised and selected versions. See [console selection](../console-selection.md) for default protocol None, operation-specific ceilings, computed location and no fallback retry after failure.

Flavor identity finding scans all `/flavors/detail` results without a name hint, adding `is_public=None` only to lists when omitted by the caller. Extra-specs enrichment is disabled by default. `resource.WithIdentityFindExtraSpecs(true)` fetches the returned ID's `/os-extra_specs` only when the single result has empty ExtraSpecs. The follow-up GET receives no caller query; failures are not hidden as absence. This option is Flavor-only, without summary/all-projects modes.

For explicit-ID `get_flavor`, use `FindIdentity` with `FindFallbackNever` and strict missing handling. `Servers.Metadata` returns a string map for both Python metadata-read names. `KeyPairs.Get` fetches a name and optional owner directly. `Servers.ConsoleOutput` distinguishes omitted length from zero; native `ShowConsoleOutput` remains available. See [compute reads](../user-read-apis.md) for standalone examples, defaults, typed results and Source response differences.

`RemoteConsoles.CreateConsole` applies protocol defaults and selected-version conditions, returning Resource/Wire results. `KeyPairs.DeleteKeypair` provides optional owner and default ignore-missing for direct name deletion. See [compute actions](../user-actions.md) for concrete options, omitted/null values, strict handling and preserved native APIs.

`KeyPairs.CreateKeypair` handles nullable attributes, ID/name aliases, input/response merging and ssh view defaults. `Servers.ConsoleURL` provides six legacy actions and actual raw console data. See [keypairs and consoles](../keypairs-console.md) for standalone examples, aliases/defaults and response policy.

`Servers.FindRecord` provides ID/name lookup and Source server/nested-resource fields. [Server lookup](server-find-python.md) describes missing defaults, phase-specific versions, and HTTP evidence.

`Servers.ClearPassword/Restore/LockWithOptions/UnshelveWithOptions` and direct fixed/floating IP actions expose Source bodies and optional arguments. [Server user actions](servers/python-user-actions.md) describes version ceilings and host administrator conditions.

`VolumeAttachments.ListRecords/UpdateRecord` and `ServerGroups.FindRecord` provide paging, raw results, and default lookup. [Attachments and groups](python-attachments-groups.md) explains volume swaps and all-projects permissions.

The upper-level `compute.Service.BackupServer` calls Nova createBackup, then lazily connects Glance through Connection to fetch the image and optionally wait for active status. [Server backup](../backup-server-python.md) describes defaults, phase-specific responses, the 120-second wait, and errors.

`Images` exposes owned Record methods for Nova legacy image and metadata proxies. General calls allow selected versions through 2.35; metadata allows through 2.38. Higher versions return ErrUnsupported before HTTP. [Nova images](nova-images-python.md) describes versions, default lists, Find, metadata, and actual response evidence.

[Python Proxy mappings](python-parity.md) describes server reads/actions/metadata/tags, server groups, interfaces, volume attachments, differences, and unresolved methods.

[Administrative Python Proxy mappings](python-parity-admin.md) covers host aggregates, flavor administration, hypervisors, compute services, migrations, server administrator actions, diagnostics, usage, and unresolved methods.

`conn.ProjectQuotas(ctx, project)` and `CurrentProjectQuotas(ctx)` expose Nova quotas as fixed-project singletons. `scope.InUser(ctx, user)` fixes project+user quotas. [Project quotas](quotasets/README.md) describes nil/zero/-1 limits, explicit force, separate Defaults, user queries, redirects, and retries.

`Limits.Fetch(ctx)` preserves the current project's read-only limits response; `conn.ProjectLimits(ctx, project)` fixes the project query. [Limits](limits/README.md) explains reserved 0/1, legacy rates, and raw HTTP responses.

`Servers.GetPassword` returns encrypted text by default. Select RSA decryption with `servers.WithGetPasswordPrivateKey(key)`. See [password reads](servers/README.md).

`Tags.InServer(ctx, serverRef)` resolves the server name/ID once and exposes Add/Check/List/Replace/Remove/RemoveAll. Tag sets are not Collections and require an actual selected microversion of at least 2.26. See [tag empty-list and 404 policies](tags/README.md).

Native [server calls](servers/native.md), [server groups](servergroups/README.md), [volume attachments](volumeattach/README.md), [interfaces](attachinterfaces/README.md), [extensions](extensions/README.md), [usage](usage/README.md), and [security group proxies](secgroups/README.md) accept server IDs directly, forward Gophercloud requests unchanged, and add operation context. Each guide describes paths, bodies, fixed statuses, and single-page list contracts.

[Native administrative flavor and server calls](native-admin-flavors-servers.md) covers flavor create/update/access/extra specs and server administrator actions.

[Native Nova infrastructure administration](native-admin-infra.md) describes paths, fixed statuses, and microversion-specific decoding for hypervisors, aggregates, compute services, migrations, server diagnostics, availability-zone details, and all-project usage.

`InstanceActions.InServer(ctx, serverRef)` fetches details by requestID and paginates action history. SDK-owned `ActionResource` distinguishes list and detail results, preserving extra event information, raw JSON, and headers. See [action history, versions, and permissions](instanceactions/README.md).

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.ComputeV2(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Servers.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Servers.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use standard-library `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`. Find treats missing resources as errors by default; `resource.WithIgnoreMissing()` returns `nil, nil`. Delete ignores missing resources by default.

Common Collections provide exact name lookup, duplicate-name errors, pagination, context cancellation, and preserved HTTP errors. Wait returns `ErrUnsupported` for resources without status support.

Native-pager `Resources.List/All` and parent-scope `List/All` accept `resource.WithMaxItems(n)` and `resource.WithPaginated(false)` to cap raw rows or consume only the first page. Caps apply before local name/status and Trove user-host filters. Zero is unlimited; negative values fail during lazy iteration before HTTP. Native routes do not send caps as wire limit hints and preserve explicit page sizes, queries, and headers. Full-page extraction may still fail on malformed rows beyond the cap. Existing operation-specific options remain available on native typed List; common consumption options belong to Collections/scopes. See [service list comparisons](../../docs/listing.md) for actual bindings and continuation policies.

## Mutation requests

Pass concrete options to resource Create/Update APIs. Use typed options for standard fields and With...Field for extension fields. Queries and headers use the operation's With... functions. Standard-field/header overrides and unsupported extension mechanisms are rejected before requests. The SDK implements request-builder interfaces.

Operations requiring parents use [scope objects](../../docs/scoped-resources.md), whose Create/Update methods accept the same concrete options. This API reference does not imply support for response tracking or every composite Python cloud operation.

See the [openstacksdk inventory](../../api/openstacksdk/README.md), [complete API reference](../../api/README.md), and [project README](../../README.md) for comparison criteria, Go APIs, and validation.
